The people who are still moving well and doing what they love later in life didn’t get lucky, they just didn’t stop showing up.

Knee pain that won’t quit usually isn’t a knee problem.

You’ve rested it, iced it, maybe even had it scoped, and it’s still there. The knee rarely works alone. Weak hips, stiff ankles, or poor core control can force it to take on loads it was never meant to handle.

Fix the system, not just the spot.
